card.title: Effortless Insider
card.instruction: Treat someone’s effortless movement through systems and customs as both impressive and threatening, then prove you can master every rule without help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You found the right fork instantly. That's impressive. I've memorised this banquet's etiquette guide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just copied our host. Watch me if you get stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you, but I'll identify each utensil independently.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter needs your soup bowl. Shall I tell him you're finished?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, I'll arrange my spoon so he knows. Give me a moment to recall the angle.

mechanism: A admires instant etiquette fluency and insists on independent rule performance when B offers help with a practical service cue.
confusable: Unlike competing only to know more trivia, A's mastery display is triggered by B's effortless movement through the custom and refusal of assistance.
comparison: The banquet alternative stalls over a spoon angle; the lounge alternative refuses introduction while trying to manufacture spontaneous rapport.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
